SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-02: CQL - Types - Clinical. Test these items: Code type; CodeSystem type (CQL 1.5 trial-use); Concept type; ValueSet type (CQL 1.5 trial-use); Vocabulary type (CQL 1.5 trial-use).

For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B, Clinical Operators, Equivalent: Code equivalence ignores version/display; Concept equivalence is non-empty intersection of contained Codes; Code/Concept overloads are supported.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe showed "Systolic" ~ "Blood Pressure" translated to FALSE, "Blood Pressure" ~ "Systolic" translated to FALSE, and disjoint concepts translated to TRUE. Dynamic FHIR comparison O.code ~ "Blood Pressure" produced code.coding.exists() without the target system/code predicate.
issues.root_cause: The equivalence translator treated Concept metadata as if it were a single Code dictionary. Concept dicts have a codes list and no top-level code/system, so compile-time Concept comparisons compared missing fields and dynamic FHIR comparisons generated an unconstrained coding existence check.
issues.resolution: Normalize Code and Concept operands to lists of Code entries, compare static operands by non-empty code/system intersection, and generate multi-code FHIRPath predicates for dynamic resource-side Concept comparisons.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B, Types: Concept is a structured clinical type; ValueSet and CodeSystem are Vocabulary subtypes.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe showed singleton from ([Observation] O return "Blood Pressure") is Concept and singleton from ([Observation] O return "Example VS") is Vocabulary lowered to json_extract_string(..., '$.resourceType') checks against clinical JSON values, yielding NULL/false instead of static clinical type results.
issues.root_cause: Static clinical type inference only inspected direct identifiers, parameters, and literals. It did not recurse through query return clauses, query let aliases, or singleton-from wrappers.
issues.resolution: Extend static clinical type inference to unwrap singleton-from queries and infer the clinical type of query return expressions, including return aliases defined by query let clauses.
